en.html: What was I saving my strength for? No more holding back. The biggest strike I had—finish this, right now!
en.text: What was I saving my strength for? No more holding back. The biggest strike I had—finish this, right now!

ja.html:
出し惜しみをしている場合ではないだろう。
　最大の一撃をもって、直ちに終わらせる！
ja.text:

ja.html: 村正《磁装ながれ・蒐窮おわる――》

en.html:
The sword was back in its scabbard. Around it, the power of certain destruction raged.
Release this, and everything would be finished. Everything............

　これを解き放てば、全てが終わる…………

en.html:
No. Wrong.
If I did that—
If I actually went through with it—
I would kill them.

The Railgun, that electromagnetic sword draw, did not entertain appeals. There was no setting for a little mercy. Life, soul, everything—it destroyed the lot.

I would kill this enemy whose identity I did not even know.
And then, under Muramasa's commandment, one more person also—

いや。まずい。
　そんなことをすれば。

　そんなことをしてしまえば。
　<ruby>殺してしまう<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　<ruby>電磁抜刀<rt>レールガン</rt></ruby>は<ruby>問答無用<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>の一撃だ。
　手加減など仕様はなく、徹頭徹尾生命魂魄を破壊し
尽くす。

　そうなれば。
　俺は誰とも知れぬこの敵を殺し。

　更に村正の戒律に懸けてもう一人をも――

————And with it went the last of my chances.
